# Security Policy

Security fixes are made for the latest ProxmoxBar release in the 3.x series. Upgrade to the latest version before checking whether an issue still occurs.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub's private reporting form](https://github.com/ryzenixx/proxmoxbar-macos/security/advisories/new) or email [hello@maelduret.com](mailto:hello@maelduret.com). Keep the details out of public issues while the report is being investigated.

Include the ProxmoxBar version, macOS version, relevant Proxmox VE version and the steps to reproduce the issue. Redact API tokens, credentials and other private details from logs and screenshots.

## Scope

Report issues in ProxmoxBar, its widgets or its update process here. Examples include exposed API tokens, incorrect certificate handling, commands sent to the wrong host and tampering with the direct-download update channel.

Issues in Proxmox VE itself should go to [Proxmox security](https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Security_Reporting).
